decisions.statement: A type holds or fails across files.
The files judged are the change and every file that imports the change however far.
Which file imports which is read from the index rather than from the disk.
The index read is the index the change leaves.
A module a page type names as its loader is not compiled for a change to a page of that type.
An index that is not there is refused rather than read as an index naming no importer.
A file the change does not reach is not judged.
A file importing a router app's generated route types is not judged.
A router app's generated route types are not judged.
A file under a routes folder importing no generated route types is judged like any other file.
The one program built here states no root directories.
A route reaches its generated types through the root directories its package states.
A router app's generated route types stand outside the repository.
Every router app augments one interface react-router declares.
Two apps' generated route types augment that interface incompatibly.
A program holding another app's route map types a route's params as an empty object.
A route file path two apps share is typed against whichever map the program holds.
A wrong route map draws a clean answer rather than a refusal.
Every declaration file akasha has is compiled with every change.
A declaration file states globals no import reaches.
A declaration file the change reaches is judged as any other file is judged.
A file another config compiles is compiled by that config rather than here.
A lua runtime library's config names the files that config compiles.
One program is built for a set of changes however many files that set holds.
The program is built over the files judged and the declarations alone.
This compiler draws in no ambient types the settings do not name.
The settings name every ambient type the packages folder has.
The config the program is built from is served to the compiler rather than written.
Nothing this run worked out is kept for the next.
A diagnostic against a file the change did not touch is reported once against that file.
A path the change takes away is not there for the compiler.
A path the change takes away is answered as absent rather than read from the disk.
Nothing is reported against that path and a file still importing that path is refused.
A body is read from the change the check is handed rather than from the disk.
Every body a run reads is read once and held for the rest of that run.
A file taken away after that read is judged on the body that read got.
A body the change cannot be read for at all refuses the run rather than the file.
Each file judged is judged as the change would leave that file.
A package manifest is input to this code check as readily as a body of TypeScript.
A specifier is resolved through the manifest the change leaves rather than the manifest on disk.
A workspace package is reached where the manifest the change leaves sits.
A package the change brings into being needs no link on disk to be reached.
A package the change moves is judged where that change lands the package.
The compiler is told a package's real path from the placement rather than from the link.
A name the placement misses is read from the link on disk.
An install adds a link and takes none away.
A folder under a whole-scope link resolves with no manifest of its own.
A manifest the change has reaches the files its ways in name.
A way in is read from the manifest before the change and from the manifest after that change.
Those files are judged together with everything importing those files however far.
A way in naming a file that is nowhere reaches nothing.
A page being created is compiled against its type less the properties a generator fills.
The type a body is held to is narrowed and no diagnostic is suppressed.
The narrowing is written on the line the `satisfies` clause already stands on.
A page being created and carrying no `satisfies` clause is compiled as the page stands.
No import is added for the narrowing.
An audit hands this check every file, so its program is the whole tree.
A change reading clean here can refuse at audit over a file no change roots.
A change taking away a file no import reaches and rooting nothing has the declarations judged.
Judging those costs no compiling, the program holding them already.
A lua runtime library the change moves is found where that change leaves it.
A declaration file the change moves is found where that change leaves it.
